title: Error answer of the OAuth token endpoint (RFC 6749 §5.2)
description: invalid_grant (400): the code is unknown, used, expired, or does not match the redirect_uri or code_verifier. invalid_client (401): the client id or secret is wrong, e.g. after the client was rotated; the store provisions its client again.

examples.error_description: The authorization code is invalid or expired.
